action.objective: Complete broad search over all legal moves at depth 4 to find best capture of d5 bishop or Rxd5 while keeping king safe.
action.rationale: Position is winning materially; must first satisfy broad_search with candidate_moves=[] before selecting a candidate. Key candidates include d8d5 (Rxd5 winning bishop) and d1xd5 (Qxd5), plus b7d6. Broad search identifies the strongest tactical follow-up.
